name: ontology-writer
description: Keep a business ontology above ADRs as a closed RDFS-lite graph in Turtle: build it from documents, change it through one approval summary, align realizing ADRs, query business context and view it in 3D.

interface.longDescription: Model how the business flows across features — processes, steps, events, policies, cross-step rules, concepts and actors — as a validated Turtle graph above your ADRs. Build it from documents, change it through one approval summary that carries the affected ADRs, align realizing features, give agents the business context of a feature before they change it, and open a read-only view with a 3D business city.
defaultPrompt: Build a business ontology from these documents.
Change the business ontology: orders fully paid with store credit skip the payment request.
Check my direct edits to the business ontology and propose the downstream changes.
Make this process current once its realizing features are implemented.
